lines: 🎁 Haven's first gesture: 2,000 kcal walks to Emberhold's fire — a gift, no strings. They count it, and they remember who sent it. (Trust +10.)

councilBeatText: ◈ SYSTEM: "Four fires. NO head. Interesting. GOVERNANCE LAYER: online — the council calendar, the mutual-defense ledger, the shared granary. A league of equals. The audience has never seen one survive. Prove them wrong."

🤝 The founding council: speakers from Stonebridge, Ashford, The Bloodied sit in a circle — no throne, no kneeling. This league needs its first act. Swear the war-PACT (mutual defense — any member's call is answered, or refused aloud), found the shared POOL (2,000 kcal a week from every fire into one granary, drawn in famine), or WALK from this table for now. Or REFUSE the scale itself — stay a free fire at regional, whatever that costs. The System will not offer twice.

🌾 The shared granary is founded: Stonebridge, Ashford, The Bloodied each pour 2,000 kcal into one pool — 6,000 kcal under no one's roof and everyone's. Some fires poured short — the council's book shows every grain, and every gap. Draw on it in famine; every draw is written in the council's book. The war-pact is sworn beside it: any member's call gets answered, or refused aloud. (Trust +6 each.)
